SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN invoices.currency = 'USD' THEN invoices.amount_cents
      ELSE invoices.amount_cents / fx_rates.usd_per_unit
    END
    -
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT SUM(refunds.amount_cents)
        FROM refunds
        WHERE refunds.invoice_id = invoices.id
      ) / fx_rates.usd_per_unit,
      0
    )
  ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM
  invoices
JOIN
  fx_rates ON invoices.currency = fx_rates.currency
WHERE
  invoices.status = 'paid'
  AND invoices.paid_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'

SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN invoices.currency = 'USD' THEN invoices.amount_cents
      ELSE invoices.amount_cents * fx_rates.usd_per_unit
    END
  ) -
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN invoices.currency = 'USD' THEN refunds.amount_cents
      ELSE refunds.amount_cents * fx_rates.usd_per_unit
    END
  ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM
  invoices
LEFT JOIN
  refunds ON invoices.id = refunds.invoice_id
LEFT JOIN
  fx_rates ON invoices.currency = fx_rates.currency
WHERE
  invoices.status = 'paid'
  AND invoices.paid_at BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
